title: Exhortation to a Virgin
english: Sentences addressed to a virgin: An exhortation to a virgin. 1 Love the Lord and he will love you, and serve him and he will enlighten your heart. 2 Honor your mother as the mother of Christ, and do not provoke the one who gave birth to you. 3 Love your sisters as the daughters of your mother, and do not abandon the way of peace. 4 As the sun rises, let it see the book in your hands, and after the second hour, let it see your work. 5 Pray unceasingly, and remember Christ who begot you. 6 Avoid the company of men, so that idols may not be generated in your soul and there may not be an obstacle for you in a time of prayer. 7 You have Christ as beloved; reject from you all men, and you will not live a reproachful life. 8 Make anger and wrath far from you, and let resentment not nest within you. 9 Do not say, 'Today I will eat and tomorrow I will not eat,' for you do not do this with prudence. For there will be harm to your body and pain to your stomach. 10 To eat meat not good and to drink wine not good, but to offer these things to those who are weak, is [required]. 11 A reckless virgin will not be saved, and a profligate one will not see her bridegroom. 12 Do not say, 'The maidservant has grieved me and I will punish her,' because there is no slavery among the daughters of God. 13 Do not give your hearing to vain words, and flee the tales of gossiping old women. 14 Do not see festivals through drunkenness, and do not enter into the weddings of others. For every virgin doing these things is unclean before the Lord. 15 Open your mouth with the word of God, and restrain your tongue from much talk. 16 Humble yourself before the Lord (Ps 37:6), and his right hand will exalt you. 17 Do not turn away from a poor person in a time of distress, and there will not fail oil in your lamp. 18 Do everything through the Lord, and do not seek glory from men, for glory...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
